sentences.text:
For the Informant : Mr. Sanjay Kumar Pandey, Advocate.
.....
Order No.03/ Dated:21.03.2023 Heard learned counsel for the parties.

Apprehending his arrest in connection with Mango P.S. Case No. 228 of 2022 instituted under Sections 323/ 341/ 342/ 354(B)/ 406/498A/ 120B of the Indian Penal Code and Section 3/4 of DP Act, the petitioner has moved to this Court for grant of privilege of anticipatory bail.
Learned counsel for the petitioner has submitted that both the parties have settled their dispute before the mediation center, JHALSA.
Hence, the petitioner may be extended the privilege of anticipatory bail.
Considering the facts and circumstances of this case and also in view of settlement between the parties, I am inclined to grant privilege of anticipatory bail to the petitioner.

Accordingly, the petitioner is directed to surrender in the Court below within four weeks from today and in the event of his arrest or surrendering, he will be enlarged on bail on furnishing bail bond of Rs.20,000/-
(Rupees Twenty Thousand) with two sureties of the like amount each to the satisfaction of learned Judicial Magistrate, 1st Class, at Jamshedpur in connection with Mango P.S. Case No. 228 of 2022 with the condition that petitioner shall file an undertaking at the time of furnishing bail bond regarding the compliance of terms and conditions of settlement and subject to the conditions as laid down under Section 438(2) of the Code of Criminal Procedure.
In case of violation of terms and condition, the learned trial court itself shall cancel the anticipatory bail of the petitioner.

Petitioner will co-operate with the investigation of the case and appear before the investigating officer as and when noticed by him and furnish his mobile number and photocopy of the Aadhar Card with an undertaking that he will not change his mobile number during the pendency of the case.

(Pradeep Kumar Srivastava, J.) R.K/
